_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base rate is a coil (only 15% of 12h windows move ±2+); no breaker in funding, F&G, or range, so stay on the Complacency rung until range or sentiment band breaks.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative bearish on flows/price but no alternate phase call — split on tone not on ladder position
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-54 and BTC stays range-bound as dvol and options skew cool without a range break
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks below 39 or above 62, or BTC leaves the range while exchange netflow and dvol stay elevated
